body:
While working on temporal project, I scanned the dependency manifest and found that it uses a vulnerable version of **`github.com/aws/aws-sdk-go-v2/aws/protocol/eventstream`**. The scan revealed a denial-of-service issue where malformed EventStream headers can trigger a panic in the decoder, potentially crashing the application.

[CVE Report](https://vulert.com/vuln-scan/list/54895533-b671-4921-9105-84a6906172f8?sort_order=desc&sort_by=created_at)
[CVE Link](https://vulert.com/vuln-db/denial-of-service-due-to-panic-in-aws-sdk-for-go-v2-sdk-eventstream-decoder)
